The run therefore wrote 2 open human-gate rows into the LIVE registry instead of the sandbox.

isolationIncident.repair: db+wal+shm backed up to .tmp/shopify-verify-20260930/live-db-backup/, then the 2 rows deleted by exact id; live registry re-read: gates 4 -> 2, experiments 59, channels 10, ledger 0 — identical to the pre-run snapshot.
isolationIncident.prevention: Pin AGENT_TEAMS_DB_PATH in addition to AGENTICOS_DATA_DIR for every sandbox run; the isolated re-run confirmed sandbox 2 -> 3 gates while live stayed at 2.
